units.source_text: 没找着婴儿的亲生父母，不能收作养女，

en.t: Since the baby's birth parents could not be found, they could not take her in as an adopted daughter,

units.source_text: 所以户口册上申报为太吉郎夫妇的亲生闺女，取名千重子。

en.t: so they registered her in the family register as the biological daughter of Taichiro and his wife, and named her Chieko.
